title: jev result
description: The result of an evaluation, as `jev eval`, `jev noul`, `jev choice` and `jev score` print it with `-o json` (and `jev mcp serve` returns it). `jev eval` puts every answer under `answers`, keyed by question id, exactly as the API returned it; the one-question commands put their answer's own fields (`type`, `noul`, `choice`, `score`, ...) at the top level instead. `gate` is present only when a gating flag was used. New fields may be added; existing ones do not change within a major version.

model.description: The versioned id of the model that answered, such as `jev-1.13.0`.

requested_model.description: The model name the request used, which may be an alias such as `jev-latest`.

noul.description: The probability of yes, from 0 (no) to 1 (yes).

anyOf.description: The probability that the answer to a yes/no question is yes.

probabilities.description:
Every option mapped to its probability. The values sum to 1, within rounding.

The server does not return options in the order they were asked.

confidence.description: How certain the model is, from 0 to 1, derived from `probabilities`.

anyOf.description: The chosen option and the probability of every option.

score.description: The probability-weighted level. It can land between two levels.

additionalProperties.description: Free-form content: a string, an object, an array, or null.

legend.description:
Each level, as a **string** key such as `"0"`, mapped back to its description.

The API reference types the description as a string, but the server echoes whatever the
question used for that level, including an object or an array.

probabilities.description: Each level, as a **string** key matching `legend`, mapped to its probability.

confidence.description: How certain the model is, from 0 to 1, derived from `probabilities`.

anyOf.description: The probability-weighted level and the probability of every level.
An answer this version of the crate does not understand, kept as the raw JSON received.

additionalProperties.description: The answer to one question. The `type` field mirrors the question's type. An answer of a type this version does not understand is passed through as the raw JSON received.

answers.description: One answer per question, exactly as the API returned them.

input_tokens.description: Tokens read: the state, every question, and a fixed per-request overhead.

output_tokens.description: Tokens produced. Reported by the API but not billed.

usage.description: Token usage. Only input tokens are billed.

cost_usd.description: The estimated cost in US dollars, or `null` when the model's price is not known.

request_id.description: The `x-typesafe-request-id` to quote when asking TypeSafe about this request.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock time for the call, including retries, in milliseconds.

passed.description: `true` when every condition holds. `false` means exit code 10.

abstained.description: `true` when the answer fell inside the abstain band, which means exit code 11.

condition.description: The condition, as it was understood.

actual.description: The value the condition was compared with.

gate.description: The outcome of the gate, present only when a gating flag was used.

anyOf.description:
The documented result of an evaluation.

This shape is versioned public API. `answers` is what the API returned, passed through
unmodified, so a field this version of `jev` does not know still reaches the caller.
anyOf.title: jev eval: every answer under `answers`
